description: Require an exact Trino dialect, read-only identity and metadata allowlist before any governed query path is proposed.

guide.applicability: Use to classify a metadata gap for a named catalog, schema and bounded question.
guide.context_boundary: The SQLite Explorer and generic SQL text do not prove Trino identity, transaction, function or resource controls.
steps: Define the catalog, schema, metadata relation, fields and read-only purpose.
Check for an exact registered Trino capability with dialect, identity, allowlist and resource budgets.
Return the unsupported gap and required evidence; do not route through SQLite or arbitrary SQL.
guide.title: Trino metadata readiness review

summary: Assess a metadata question without claiming unsupported Trino execution.
